text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Copano Rickey really wants to
enter the
Japanese Derby, we
experience some minor
trouble right
before it begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ouuuch, that smarts...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm okay. I just twisted my ankle a little.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. So this is what my feng shui was
warning me
about... Things might have
ended a lot worse if
this were the actual
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having suffered a light sprain, she is
forced to
withdraw from the race. What
she decides to do
instead, however...
choice_data_list: その様子じゃ『日本ダービー』は……

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Uma Dash 7—the UmaTube
channel
bringing you live-streamed races
with a breezy,
upbeat vibe!

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're bringing you the Japanese
Derby,
and our special guest is none
other than the
Umamusume who's been
making waves with her
feng shui,
Copano Rickey!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super
happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She chooses to appear on an UmaTube

commentator channel.

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
So, Rickey, before we get to your
predictions... I
wanted to ask if there was
a chance you would've
entered this
race?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There was! And because of that, I'm
quite familiar
with each runner's
potential. Having thoroughly
researched
the venue, I think my predictions
should
be fairly accurate.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, if we're talking about the Japanese
Derby...
this year is said to be a
showdown between four
powerful titans.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The favorite for this race normally chases
from
the rear of the pack, but the Derby
is a race
where you need to stay up front
if you're hoping
to win.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The pace is quite slow on the whole, so
there's a
high chance the leaders will
stay in the lead. The
odds are against
her. However...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The favorite is number one in bracket
one. And
today's lucky color is white!
Also...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The inner track is a vivid shade of green.
Her
affinity couldn't be better!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, from a feng shui perspective, she
shouldn't
have any problem pushing
through.

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Some people are predicting it might be
difficult
for her if she gets boxed in
though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think she'll manage to push through all
the same.
White waves carry more power
than blue surges,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Also, besides the four titans, there's
another
Umamusume worth keeping an
eye on—bracket
two, post three, the
black-haired runner.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As for the "white wave" Umamusume...
The
stronger her performance from the
back of the
pack, the farther her light
will reach, drowning
out the shadows
ahead. Keep an eye on her! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's feng shui-themed
commentary
keeps everyone hyped. And
then...

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable?! Number one takes the
win! She
came surging from behind along
the outside, and
delivered exactly what
her fans had hoped!

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
And how about Rickey's other
mark—number
three from bracket two...

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Third place! She crosses the finish line in
third
place! With an incredible start and
strong
perseverance, her display today
far exceeded her
popularity!

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text: Rickey, how did you know?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special. I considered all their
talent
and luck, then chose the racers
who appeared on
top.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The racers I named, the people watching
us from
home—anyone can call forth
happiness by
shaping their environment!
That is feng shui. ☆

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's truly incredible! I feel like
I've
gotten a glimpse into the true power
of feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Commentator MC
text_block_list.text:
Rickey, make sure you come and hang
out with us
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'd be happy to! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, look Trainer! That store over there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The feng shui shop is packed with
people!
I've never seen it this crowded
before!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, check out these stones. Aren't they
so
pretty? Apparently, it's best to get
them in your
lucky color.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking about buying a book. I
wanna know
the best things to place
near my pillow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shop is bustling with crowds of
customers.
There's even a large banner
outside.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The banner says... let's see—Popularized by Copano Rickey! The Miraculous Power of Feng Shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I'm glad that it's becoming
popular, but
branding it as miraculous
seems a bit over the
top.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I prefer a more grounded
approach
showing people how practicing
feng shui leads to
improving one's own
luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The presentation may be hyperbolic, but
it's
better than having no one interested
at all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This must be because of what I did
during the
Japanese Derby. I knew it
would garner a whole
different level of
attention! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I hope now even more people will start
getting
interested in feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, check out this letter! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It says, "Trying out your feng shui has
made me a
little more positive-minded!
Now, I'm a huge
fan! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can really feel it—feng shui is
gradually
helping spread happiness to
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, this is perfect! As we enter the
ninth
solar term, summer welcomes us
with a bountiful
harvest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I hope my feng shui spreads far and
wide! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she wasn't able to run in the
Derby herself
like initially planned,
Copano Rickey's accurate
Derby
predictions do the trick, sparking a feng

shui craze.
